page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the paragraph that begins "Anglia praecipuae".

main_text.p: ferentes, cibis ut inutiles, abdicandi. Porro in coquendo elixandoq; artificium adhibetur non paruum, ut durior evadat, dura enim piscium caro gratior est, mollis insalubris.

Apparatum hunc culinæ germanorum pri-mum videntur docuisse alios, nam condi-menta, quæ hodie luciis adhibentur, lautio-ra, à populis quibusdam germanica appel-lantur. Fit autem id genus condimenti ex si-napi & butyro prunis liquato. Alii edunt ex aceto piperato: alii & quidem lautiores frigunt, exque liquore mali aurantii affu-munt: alii craticula, præsertim vero lucio-los, torrent, prius tamen utrinque scarifica-tionibus cute aperta, ut butyrum, quo li-quato in craticula humectatur, penitus sub-eat.

Anglia luciis no-bilitatis[?]Anglia præcipuæ nobilitatis lucios o-stentat, ventribusque eorum cultro apertis, seuum pingueque, vendentes ementibus o-stendunt, & si non emantur, (mirum dictu) in aquas eos rursum coniiciunt, nec intereunt, sed vulnus celerrime coalescit, quod quidam contactui tincarum ascribunt, rin-ca enim glutinosa admodum est, alii rectius eam vim iis inesse à natura affirmant, inventum enim est interaneis lucii coagulari lac, ac glaciari æque ac coa-gulo.

page.notes: The running head reads as "PROPAGANDA" but the letters are spaced and partly unclear. The page number "495" is printed at the top right and is doubtful. The marginal note "luciis" may read "lucius". "De" at the foot is a catchword, not a heading. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The bottom "De" is also given as a catchword above; it appears only once in the output.
